progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on C in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:12.4) introduces Dk, centred on C. Phrase 4 (0:36.0) introduces F, centred on C. Phrase 6 (0:56.0) introduces Eb, Ab, centred on C. Phrase 12 (3:47.6) introduces G, centred on C. The line peaks at Eb5 (649.4 Hz) at 4:28.7. It closes on Dk4, not the tonic (F4 → Eb4 → F4 → Eb4 → C4 → Dk4).
